helpMove: m <col> [<col>]      move top card between tableau columns
helpMoveTF: m t <col> f          move tableau to foundation
helpMoveTT: m t <col> <idx> t <col>  move tableau to tableau
invalidFromZone: Invalid source zone: {{.val}} (only t is valid)
moveUsage: Usage: m t <col> <cardIdx> t <col> or m t <col> f
blockMoveRule: Tip: grab any face-up card — everything stacked on it moves along, in any order (only the bottom card has to fit the destination).
hintConfidenceFoundation: (priority: high - safe move to a foundation)
helpExampleAuto: ac                   send everything that can go to a foundation
errNotPlaying: The game is not in play.
errBadFromColumn: That source column does not exist.
errBadToColumn: That destination column does not exist.
errSameColumn: The source and destination columns are the same.
errBadCardIndex: That column has no card at that index.
errCardFaceDown: A face-down card cannot be moved.
errCannotPlaceTableau: A tableau card only goes on a card of the opposite colour, one rank higher.
errBadFoundationCard: That card cannot go to a foundation.
errCannotPlaceFoundation: A foundation only takes the same suit, one rank higher.
errNotAllFaceUp: Cards are still face down, so the game cannot be finished automatically.
errUndoNotPlaying: The game is not in play, so there is nothing to undo.
errNothingToUndo: There is no move to undo.
